title: Desigualdad y desarrollo
goal: Read about Mexico's Progresa program -- a conditional cash transfer for rural mothers -- and Brazil's Bolsa Família as responses to inequality that outlasted decades of shifting development models.

items: Explain why inequality remained unresolved despite changing development models.
Describe what Progresa was and its conditions.
Explain Levy's admission about the limits of experimental design.
State what Bolsa Família achieved in Brazil under Lula.
Use por más que + subjunctive to introduce an emphatic concession.
